title: No block outline
description: Remove the block outline when you look at a block
body:
# 🚫 No Block Outline

Enjoy a cleaner, more immersive view by removing the **No block outline** that appears when looking at blocks.

## ✨ Features

* 👀 Removes the block highlight/selection outline.
* 🎮 Creates a cleaner, distraction-free gameplay experience.
* 🧱 Preserves Minecraft's vanilla look while reducing visual clutter.
* 💜 Perfect for screenshots, cinematics, or players who prefer a minimalist HUD.
